_note: Visual directions. tokens are the only colours a design may use (lint flags others). radius is in canvas units (1u = short side / 100). pattern: dots | grid | stripes | rays | waves | clouds | none. texture: grain | paper | none. deco: sticker | line | soft | seal | none decides badges and frames. image_style feeds the image prompt.

pop-fresh.name: 元气撞色
pop-fresh.mood: 热闹、好吃、年轻，一眼看到优惠
pop-fresh.image_style: bright flat illustration or punchy studio product photo, saturated warm colours, clean colour-block background, playful
pop-fresh.image_style_zh: 明亮的扁平插画或冲击力强的棚拍产品照，饱和暖色，干净的色块背景，活泼
pop-fresh.avoid: 大面积暗色、细线条宋体、低饱和莫兰迪色

warm-hand.name: 暖手作
warm-hand.mood: 温暖、真诚、有手艺人的温度
warm-hand.image_style: warm natural light, handmade texture, linen and wood, soft film grain, cosy close-up
warm-hand.image_style_zh: 温暖的自然光，手作质感，亚麻和木头，轻微胶片颗粒，温馨的近景
warm-hand.avoid: 荧光色、科技感几何、硬朗黑体大字

clean-minimal.name: 清爽极简
clean-minimal.image_style: minimal still life, soft daylight, lots of negative space, neutral background, editorial product photo
clean-minimal.image_style_zh: 极简静物，柔和日光，大量留白，中性背景，杂志感产品照
clean-minimal.avoid: 满屏装饰、多种强调色、贴纸感

editorial.name: 杂志感
editorial.mood: 有观点、有格调，像一本杂志的版面
editorial.image_style: editorial photography, strong single subject, dramatic natural light, magazine cover composition
editorial.image_style_zh: 杂志摄影，单一强主体，戏剧性的自然光，杂志封面式构图
editorial.avoid: 圆角卡片、卡通插画、渐变

dark-premium.name: 黑金质感
dark-premium.image_style: low-key lighting, dark background, warm rim light, luxurious materials, shallow depth of field
dark-premium.image_style_zh: 低调布光，深色背景，暖色轮廓光，高级材质，浅景深

guochao.name: 新中式
guochao.mood: 东方、雅致、有节气和茶的味道
guochao.image_style: new Chinese style, rice paper texture, ink wash accents, muted vermilion and pine green, elegant still life
guochao.image_style_zh: 新中式风格，宣纸质感，水墨点缀，低饱和朱砂红和松石绿，雅致静物
guochao.avoid: 荧光色、圆滚滚的卡通字、科技蓝

trust-blue.name: 稳重专业
trust-blue.image_style: clean corporate photography, natural office light, confident people at work, calm blue-grey palette
trust-blue.image_style_zh: 干净的商务摄影，自然的办公室光线，自信的工作场景，沉稳的蓝灰色调
trust-blue.avoid: 贴纸、手写字、高饱和撞色

soft-pastel.name: 柔和治愈
soft-pastel.image_style: soft pastel palette, airy high-key light, gentle and cute, rounded shapes
soft-pastel.image_style_zh: 柔和粉彩色调，明亮通透的高调光，温柔可爱，圆润的造型
soft-pastel.avoid: 纯黑大面积、尖锐几何、粗壮黑体

sport-bold.name: 动感力量
sport-bold.mood: 有劲、利落、让人想动起来
sport-bold.image_style: high contrast sports photography, hard light, motion, sweat and energy, dark background
sport-bold.image_style_zh: 高反差运动摄影，硬光，动感，汗水和力量，深色背景
sport-bold.avoid: 粉彩、细宋体、大量留白的文艺排版

campus-fresh.name: 校园清新
campus-fresh.image_style: bright friendly illustration, clean flat shapes, sunny palette, school and learning motifs
campus-fresh.image_style_zh: 明亮友好的插画，干净的扁平造型，阳光配色，学校和学习元素

festive-red.name: 喜庆红
festive-red.mood: 隆重、喜气、有过节和开张的仪式感
festive-red.image_style: festive Chinese red and gold, lanterns and paper-cut accents, warm celebratory light
festive-red.image_style_zh: 喜庆的中国红和金色，灯笼和剪纸点缀，温暖热烈的节日光线

garden-romance.name: 森系浪漫
garden-romance.mood: 清新、温柔、有仪式感，像一场草坪婚礼
garden-romance.image_style: airy garden wedding, soft natural daylight, eucalyptus and blush flowers, film-like softness, elegant and calm
garden-romance.image_style_zh: 草坪婚礼的通透感，柔和的自然光，尤加利叶和淡粉色花，胶片般的柔和，优雅安静
garden-romance.avoid: 大红大金、粗壮黑体、荧光色

xi-red.name: 喜事红
xi-red.mood: 端庄、喜气、有老规矩的体面
xi-red.image_style: traditional Chinese wedding red and gold, paper-cut double happiness, silk and embroidery textures, warm candle light, elegant
xi-red.image_style_zh: 传统中式喜事的正红和金色，剪纸囍字，丝绸和刺绣质感，温暖的烛光，端庄雅致
xi-red.avoid: 黑白大色块、荧光色、卡通字体、促销式放射光芒
